scoring.method: Side by side: a crop of the target next to one image per candidate (our builder render, a bench render, the official r187 example screenshot, or the CC0 asset's thumbnail), in docs/gate/scene-quality/sources/<id>.jpg. The score (0-10) is the scene-quality worker's visual judgement of closeness to the target in colour, surface detail, light response and shape, written down with a short reason; not a metric. Our renders are SwiftShader (provisional, L4). Paid candidates are listed and flagged, not downloaded and not scored.

build.base: 3DPLAT Blender palm GLB (palm_lod0, palm_lod1, card) with baked AO and leaf maps
tsl_layers: rooted sway + per-frond bend with its own phase + leaflet flutter
light through the leaflets: forward scatter + wrapped back term, thickness-weighted
hashed alpha under TRAA (High), alpha test with mip boost elsewhere
bark: fibre + boot-ring height, derivative normal, sky rim sheen
AO: baked x crown inner shading

pick.gap: Best free candidate 7/10 (A). Below the bar: trunk lacks the target's strong diamond leaf-boot relief and warm colour; crown density lower. To try: a boot-pattern height field (diamond lattice) driving the derivative normal and AO, warmer bark, denser frond GLB from our Blender script.
